title: Модальные нюансы: needn't have vs didn't need to, be to, be bound to, be supposed to

why: Модальные глаголы выражают не только «могу» и «должен», но и тонкие оттенки: необходимость в прошлом, договорённость, уверенность, ожидание. Русский часто передаёт всё это одним словом «должен», поэтому английские нюансы нужно запомнить отдельно.
formation: • needn't have + V3: сделал, но это было не нужно. I needn't have waited.
• didn't need to + инфинитив: не нужно было (и мы не знаем, делали ли это). I didn't need to wait.
• be to + инфинитив: по плану, по приказу или договорённости. We are to meet at nine.
• be bound to + инфинитив: наверняка, неизбежно. She is bound to know.
• be supposed to + инфинитив: предполагается, должен по правилам или плану. You are supposed to wear a badge.
usage: 1. Needn't have + V3 — действие было, но оказалось лишним. (I needn't have brought an umbrella; it didn't rain. = Зря я взял зонт, дождя не было.) Didn't need to — действия могло и не быть, а если было, то необязательно. (I didn't need to bring an umbrella, so I left it at home. = Зонт мне не был нужен, и я оставил его дома.)

2. Be to — официальный план, инструкция, договорённость. (The president is to visit Berlin next week. = Президент должен посетить Берлин на следующей неделе. / You are not to touch this button. = Эту кнопку трогать нельзя.)

3. Be bound to — высокая вероятность или неизбежность. (He's bound to be late; he always is. = Он наверняка опоздает, он всегда опаздывает. / With that attitude you are bound to fail. = С таким отношением ты обязательно провалишься.)

4. Be supposed to — ожидается по правилам или плану; в прошедшем времени часто означает, что этого не случилось. (The train is supposed to arrive at six. = Поезд должен прибыть в шесть. / I was supposed to call her, but I forgot. = Я должен был ей позвонить, но забыл.) Иногда значит «считается»: He is supposed to be a good doctor. = Говорят, он хороший врач.
signalWords: unnecessarily, in the end, it turned out; according to the plan / schedule / rules; for sure, certainly, sooner or later; supposed to обычно со словами still, again, but.
mistakes: ✗ I needn't to have gone. → ✓ I needn't have gone. После needn't нет to.
✗ I didn't need to go, but I went, and it was a waste. → ✓ I needn't have gone. Если действие уже случилось зря, используем needn't have.
✗ He bound to win. → ✓ He is bound to win. Нужен глагол be.
✗ She is suppose to call. → ✓ She is supposed to call. Нужно -ed.
✗ We are to going to meet. → ✓ We are to meet. После be to идёт инфинитив без going.
remember: Needn't have + V3 — «зря сделал»; be to — план; be bound to — «точно будет»; be supposed to — «положено».

items.prompt: I took a taxi, but I ___ (not, need) it. The bus was right there. (needn't have + V3)
items.answer: needn't have taken

items.prompt: He is very experienced. He is ___ to find a solution.
items.answer: bound

items.prompt: You are not ___ to use your phone during the exam.
items.answer: supposed

items.prompt: The conference is ___ to start at ten.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: We ___ (not, hurry). The train was late. (needn't have + V3)
items.answer: needn't have hurried

items.prompt: She is ___ to be angry when she hears this.
items.answer: bound

items.prompt: I'm ___ to meet the client at noon.
items.answer: supposed

items.prompt: You ___ (not, buy) a gift; we have everything we need. (needn't have + V3)
items.answer: needn't have bought

items.prompt: I (a) needn't have called (b) didn't need to called him; he was already here.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: We (a) are bound (b) are to going to lose if we don't practice.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: Yesterday was a holiday, so I (a) needn't have got up (b) didn't need to get up early.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: The new policy (a) is to (b) is bound take effect next month.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: He (a) is suppose (b) is supposed to be at the office by nine.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: You (a) needn't have to (b) needn't have worried. Everything was fine.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: It's a famous restaurant. It's (a) bound to (b) bound be crowded.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: You (a) are to not (b) are not to enter this room.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: I'm sure she will win. (используйте bound) → She ...
items.answer: She is bound to win.

items.prompt: According to the schedule, the bus arrives at five. (supposed) → The bus ...
items.answer: The bus is supposed to arrive at five.

items.prompt: It was unnecessary for me to wait, but I waited. (needn't have) → I ...
items.answer: I needn't have waited.

items.prompt: The plan is that the team meets on Monday. (be to) → The team ...
items.answer: The team is to meet on Monday.

items.prompt: The rules say you must not park here. (supposed) → You ...
items.answer: You are not supposed to park here.

items.prompt: It was unnecessary to book a table, but we booked one. (needn't have) → We ...
items.answer: We needn't have booked a table.

items.prompt: I'm sure he will forget the password again. (bound) → He ...
items.answer: He is bound to forget the password again.

items.prompt: The instruction says you must not open this file. (be to) → You ...
items.answer: You are not to open this file.

items.prompt: I needn't to have gone to the meeting.
items.answer: I needn't have gone to the meeting.

items.prompt: He bound to be late.
items.answer: He is bound to be late.

items.prompt: You are suppose to wear a helmet here.
items.answer: You are supposed to wear a helmet here.

items.prompt: We are to going to start at nine.
items.answer: We are to start at nine.

items.prompt: I needn't have worry about the exam.
items.answer: I needn't have worried about the exam.

items.prompt: She is bound win the competition.
items.answer: She is bound to win the competition.

items.prompt: They are to not enter the lab without permission.
items.answer: They are not to enter the lab without permission.

items.prompt: I was supposed call him yesterday.
items.answer: I was supposed to call him yesterday.

items.prompt: Мне не нужно было вставать рано, поэтому я спал до десяти.
items.answer: I didn't need to get up early, so I slept until ten.

items.prompt: Зря я купил этот билет, концерт отменили.
items.answer: I needn't have bought this ticket; the concert was cancelled. / I needn't have bought this ticket; the concert was canceled.

items.prompt: Она наверняка знает ответ.
items.answer: She is bound to know the answer.

items.prompt: Релиз должен состояться в пятницу.
items.answer: The release is supposed to happen on Friday. / The release is to take place on Friday. / The release is supposed to take place on Friday.

items.answer: You needn't have come so early. / You didn't need to come so early.

items.prompt: Если ты не будешь тестировать код, у тебя обязательно будут баги.
items.answer: If you don't test your code, you are bound to have bugs. / If you don't test the code, you are bound to have bugs.

items.prompt: Сотрудникам запрещено пользоваться личными ноутбуками.
items.answer: Employees are not to use personal laptops. / Employees are not supposed to use personal laptops.
